notes.title: Update 1.0
notes.content:
The next update will be 1.0, which will mark the end of early access on September 19. The changes will be briefly described below.


Game ending:
Cinematics, combat, dialogue, the opening of the wormhole… Most of the development time has been spent on this section, and it's the one I'm going to give the fewest details about to avoid spoiling the ending. But I'm sure you'll like it.


Achievements:
13 achievements have been added. Only one of them is hidden, and all can be unlocked in a single playthrough. The achievements will be visible from the moment this announcement is published, but for testing purposes only. They cannot be obtained with version 0.9 of the game. To obtain them, you'll have to wait until the release of version 1.0 on September 19.


Mountains:
A new level of realism has been added to the environment. The map generation code has been modified to favor the appearance of high mountains, as this is the only place where the rarest minerals can be found. Jagged rocks have also been added to the sides of mountains, deserts, and grasslands. These new jagged rocks make it more difficult to access higher areas, and most of the time you'll have to take a detour or spend time climbing between them. Plants were previously not allowed to generate in steeper areas, these areas are now covered in rocks.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931366/5f982acf59c658fe6d086d9a414172bd06b17fea.png"]
Interface improvement:
Multiple images have been added and some shaders have been added to interface elements. Some menus and the loading screen have been redesigned.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931366/daf57220a4e5f8b423dff050a56baa350dc98586.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931366/0c7dbec176c26982f7c87ca435377938f5941044.png"]

Graphic improvement:
New post-processing effects have been added, and existing ones have been adjusted and improved.

Insects have been added to different areas of the terrain, along with vultures to locate fallen enemies. Flocks of birds have been added to trees, which will scatter when hit.

Many animations have been improved, including eating, drinking, bow animations, and existing cinematics.

Impact effects have been added to all types of contact surfaces. Any game element that blocks movement is now susceptible to displaying an impact effect when hit with a weapon.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931366/0e61d81fe0b25121e016899faa47ee3666b8bc3e.png"]

Sound:
All missing sound effects have been added. Sounds of falling trees, rivers, lakes, and enemies. Sound effects for magic abilities, food, drink, insects, birds, and many others.

Items:
Various food items have been added. They can be found in shops and abandoned houses in villages. Perishable foods will be rotten and eating them will be counterproductive.





All improvements and additions will be detailed in more depth on the day of release. See you on September 19.

notes.title: Update 0.9
notes.content:
Hello survivors! Update 0.9 is now available. Below are the changes made during this update:

Performance:
During this stage of development, a lot of time has been invested in optimization. To increase the realism of the environment, procedural generation stages have been added in the latest updates, with a consequent increase in load times. Generation time was not an issue initially, as the set of stages did not exceed 30 seconds, but it could become cumbersome if a game was loaded repeatedly in a short space of time. To solve these loading times, generation phases are now only performed when starting a new game. The data generated is stored on the hard drive, slightly increasing the size of the save file from a few kilobytes to around 5 megabytes, and reducing loading time by around 80%, from around 30 seconds to around 6 seconds. This work may go unnoticed since it is not visual, but it was necessary to speed up the flow of the game.

Constructions of old survivors:
To further enrich the game's environment, old abandoned bases from other survivors are now generated. In most cases these buildings are half-ruined due to lack of use, but all of them provide a starting point for starting a new base, since you can build using their intact parts as a starting point. All of these buildings are closed, their doors and windows are unusable, and there are always valuable items inside, so it is worth investing time in destroying a part to gain access to the interior. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931366/6559deb558951aea328301957011afb28c938a84.png
The construction menu has been redesigned, doors and windows are now separate buildings, so you will first have to build a door or window frame. A new type of triangular wall has also been added to fill the gaps left by ceilings when built on odd-numbered walls.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931366/6b9d9fbf1e83f5ff94459c9a490f199d92eb93c8.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931366/52aaf0804fd4cc5b66e1a7686f74ae6ead0c2d81.png

Enemies and Combat:
Enemy AI has been significantly improved as detailed below:

Extra checkpoints have been added to improve their vision and make them more realistic, they can now see the player even if only part of their body is visible behind cover.
Repositioning has been improved when facing large groups, they no longer push each other to take the shortest path, they are always evenly distributed around the player.
The maximum number of enemies attacking at the same time has been decreased to prevent them from blocking the player's movement.
A displacement mechanic has been added, it is activated when performing a successful kick on an enemy, displacing him backwards and blocking his movement for a few seconds. The energy consumption of kicks has been considerably increased to avoid abuse and to make it an action to perform if you want to escape or reposition yourself.
A stun mechanic has been added, hits to an enemy's head leave them stunned for 3 seconds, after which they have 10 seconds of invulnerability to stuns, this mechanic also applies to the player, if he receives a blow to the head he is stunned and unable to perform any action for 2 seconds, after which he has 10 seconds of invulnerability to stuns.
Differentiated colliders have been added for each part of the player's body, in the same way that the enemies already had. These parts reduce the damage received in extremities and increase it in the chest and head, in this way the weaker enemies that attack the legs now do less damage, improving the learning curve of the combat.
All enemy combat animations have been modified. Now, during an attack, they move or stand still depending on their distance from the player, since before the player only had to move backwards to avoid any attack, to focus more on this mechanics and increase the realism, the speed of the player has been decreased when moving backwards by 40%.
Fixed some cases where enemies would not know how to behave around a player-owned building or a body of water or river.


Sound:
A lot of missing sound effects have been added, especially during different enemy actions.
Added or corrected the labeling of many materials so that the player's footsteps correspond to the material stepped on.
More ambient music has been added and the times between songs and conversations with Ashun have been lengthened.


Next update:
The next update will be 1.0, which will mark the exit from early access. It will focus on the end of the game, with the remodeling of the control center and the events that take place there. Other aspects of the game will also be polished, such as the visual effects of the summons, as well as their sound effects, the vegetation, especially in the mountain biome, and a general polish to the cinematics and animations.

I hope you enjoy this update!

notes.title: Update 0.8
notes.content:
Hello survivors! Update 0.8 is now available. The changes of this update are detailed below: 

Bows:
Initially the game was intended for melee combat at the beginning and ranged combat as you unlock the various summons. But this creates a gap in the transition between the beginning of the game and the end, especially when facing enemies from a distance or trying to hunt animals. This gap is now filled with the introduction of bows. 

3 types of bows have been added:
 
 Simple bow: Unlocked by default, it doesn't have a long range and doesn't cause much damage even using good arrows.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931366/4c28e5e5962b35d9f909f4526d678f9eb22ead7b.png
 Compound bow: Unlocked at level 5 with the “Basic Tools” skill. It has a good range and causes a lot of damage even with bad arrows.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931366/1c3a6a9a9dc53f5e94138ef409a72b02dd84cd2d.png
 Metal bow: Unlocked at level 9 with the “Intermediate tools” skill. It has a long range and deals huge damage even with bad arrows.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931366/1c60d168e2cb0736b1a82470ef8545aeb2bc5bdb.png

4 types of arrows have been added:
 
 Wooden arrow: Unlocked by default. Simple wooden arrow that causes little damage.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931366/a20cce37c312dd2fd837d51b791084255ea742c7.png
 Iron arrow: Unlocked at level 5 with the “Basic Tools” skill. Wooden arrow with an iron head that causes a lot of damage.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931366/926b38aab99c6d5216704029829231c85e0d4e3b.png
 Steel arrow: Unlocked at level 9 with the “Intermediate Tools” skill. Wooden arrow with a steel head that causes huge damage.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931366/a5dce8994c01e28e6df5c6f702070f0629e750f4.png
 Nightmare Arrow: Unlocked at level 12 with the “Advanced Tools” skill. Wooden arrow with alloy steel head and pointed fins, causes massive damage both going in and coming out.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931366/7afdce2cb191bd18b22b6917fbd7eaf4ae9846bf.png


Graphic update:

Most 3D models and vegetation textures have been improved.
Added volumetric fog.
Added reflections.
New system of volumetric clouds and darkening of the environment during a storm.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931366/436df35467c1ff76e0efa64ab253849f01cd1778.png

Rivers and new water rendering system:
Rivers have been added during the terrain generation phase. Depending on the height of the terrain generated with each seed, up to 5 different rivers will be created, which will start in the higher areas of the map and go down the terrain to a mass of water. The rivers will always look for the lowest adjacent terrain during their descent, this could cause some strange shapes in the terrain modeling by the erosion of the river in this version, but I hope to perfect it in the following updates. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931366/d5186d9d1ecc044b7860ae5550c8e13bcffd3590.png
Because of the way the map is generated it is inevitable that sometime a river crosses a road. For this reason now the roads dynamically generate bridges when they detect a river.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931366/8b24a2adedd3b93b88b9f82c26bc804e948c5ea9.png


Villages:
The scientific facilities are located in a very sparsely populated area, this is mainly because they used former secret military facilities. But sparsely populated does not mean that there was no one in that area. That is why now 3 towns are generated that are connected by road to the control center and antennas. One medium size with 40 buildings and the other two small ones with about 20 buildings.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931366/4ea2bd441a29f30bf131ae1dd4f541c3be061a95.png
In this update they are still in a preview version and the buildings will not have many resources to obtain. In future updates this will change and they will be points where you can get large amounts of resources.

Survivors:
Of course you are not the only person on the face of the earth, there are some people who have the same genetics as you, and therefore are also resistant to Ashun's radiation. In this update 4 survivors will be added, as it is still a preliminary version they will only be in their stores in the villages. And what do these survivors offer us? 

You will be able to trade with them. Each one will be specialized in certain materials. They will pay you more for the resources they specialize in. As you trade with them you will earn their respect, they will charge you less for their goods in addition to paying you higher amounts for yours.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931366/2755026af959635a57d8e4f757337c1d8a3790f0.png
They will offer you missions with specific objectives and rewards. Upon completing the objectives they will give you the reward, which will always include respect and experience, as well as some valuable items or money. In this preliminary version the objectives will be relatively simple, in future updates more complex missions will be created.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931366/b9d306c0321ca31550096021804f7ddb455369b4.png
As an addition to the mission system, a group of initial missions have also been created to guide new players, and make it easier for them to obtain basic resources at the beginning of the game.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931366/593fd1fc97766dbc9b7347f3cb6b7566d4c465da.png
But to sustain a trading system you need a currency. In this post-apocalyptic world, the survivors decided to adopt a small object that was difficult to fake and which acquired curious properties. The marbles. After the opening of the wormhole, the survivors noticed that the marbles began to glow. Upon observing them closely, it almost seemed as if they had a thunderstorm inside them.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931366/e7c98b7da20e733c7acc4a15df2d9953f8ed7efa.png

Next update:
The next update will be mainly focused on everything related to combat, this includes new moves, stun, displacement when kicking, a new system to control the position of the feet in relation to the ground, improve decisions when attacking and defending from enemies, improve the special effects of the summons... The summary is that all enemies and wildlife will look much better and will have a more complex and realistic behavior.
I will also focus on improving one of the most neglected aspects of the game at the moment, the sound. This includes improving some sounds, the frequency and distance at which they are played, adding new sounds to actions that are currently mute and adding some more music.

Without further ado, I hope you enjoy the update!

notes.title: Update 0.7.5
notes.content:
Hello survivors! The first update of the game is here. Below are the changes made and additions introduced to the game.

Weight:
All objects in the game now have a weight, which will influence the character's movement and the attack speed of the weapons. There are certain objects that have reduced values so as not to make the gameplay cumbersome (no one is capable of carrying 2 tons of wood or stone to make 3 walls). Weight is represented in the inventory, as you carry more weight, the character's speed will be reduced. To increase the maximum weight there are 3 methods:

Equip backpacks.
Equip belts.
Unlock the skills “Lungs of iron” and “Lungs of steel” at levels 5 and 10.

The weapons you create on the anvil will also have a weight characteristic. It is calculated from the weight of the materials used and the shape you give it. The larger the weapon, the more it will weigh. The weight will influence the speed of the attacks, if the weapon is short it will attack very fast, if it is very long it will be very slow.

Backpacks:
The start of the game was too easy, you could carry as much as you wanted and not worry about inventory space. Now inventory management and having a base with chests is a more relevant need. Inventory space has been reduced to 10 slots. This space can be increased by using backpacks. 3 backpacks have been added:

Improvised Backpack: Unlocked by default. Increases inventory capacity by 6 slots and maximum weight by 5 kilos. It can be made with 10 cloth and 30 plant fibers.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931366/17d278c3de402d1b4c58b1f081169240d036aa97.png
Medium Backpack: Unlocked at level 5 with the “Basic tools” skill. Increases inventory capacity by 13 slots and maximum weight by 15 kilos. It can be made with 20 cloth, 10 scraps of leather and an iron bar.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931366/1a1543a604a19fb373ebbdf6cc9774f6da1441cf.png
Large Backpack: Unlocked at level 9 with the “Intermediate tools” skill. Increases inventory capacity by 20 slots and maximum weight by 30 kilos. It can be made with 40 cloth, 20 scraps of leather and 2 iron bars.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931366/ed1d3a748e7456afcddfc5c747c6b6f33277cf77.png

Belts:
Much like the inventory, the action bar had too many slots at the beginning of the game. Which could lead to you equipping all your weapons only on one side and only using one hand. The purpose of the game is for you to use each limb independently, which is why the action bar has been reduced to one slot for each hand. To increase it you will have to equip belts. 2 belts have been added:

Side Belt: Unlocked at level 5 with the “Basic tools” skill. Increases the capacity of the action bar by one space for each hand and the maximum weight by 5 kilos. It can be made with 5 scraps of leather and an iron bar.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931366/4d28adc6c89258ff3cc437f2b67c87283a889485.png
Cross Belt: Unlocked at level 9 with the “Intermediate tools” skill. Increases the capacity of the action bar by 2 spaces for each hand and the maximum weight by 10 kilos. It can be made with 10 scraps of leather and a steel bar.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931366/0beb43e22c864ed21b9288c05ad10e74fd8b018c.png


Equipping backpacks and weapons in the action bar will show those objects in the world, if you look at your shadow while you have weapons equipped you will be able to see them.

Destroyer deck:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931366/2d994b1757e2a69bf382cf85c9fb75d7a17883ee.png
When you start the game and create your first base, it is usually made of wood. As you progress in the game you may want to change it for different reasons, needing more space, improving its resistance, having it reduced to rubble by a group of alien attackers... In any case there was no quick way to destroy a construction made by the player, only hit them with your weapons until they are destroyed. Now a hammer has been added whose only function is to destroy these buildings. Simply standing near the building and clicking it, it will be destroyed along with all the buildings dependent on it. This way you will make renovations quickly, but the materials are not recovered in the process.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931366/f2a0477bc1cb81c7fea2c956a87d1cf510dd91d2.png

Objects update:
The game is still in an early version and therefore there are many 3D models and textures that are not of good quality. As updates are released they will be progressively improved. In this update, trees, rocks, grass and the materials of many buildings have been improved. The following items have been added or completely redone:

Stone axe
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931366/15fc582ac346a967231cce201797e9a5a7b1593d.png
Stone pickaxe
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931366/8e2c1490a54469cd2ff6d61d2461a4735b4cb598.png
Stone spear
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931366/3d72fd4200bf35309e10c04e7f60d756fa503859.png
Cloth
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931366/94e93328417ad9912ec067ebff62c8d97c37a640.png
Rope
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931366/971ccb144b51554b9f30fc5133bd9764b9709a30.png
Leather
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931366/648f8a6c5d96a5b74bcfd67b86d51ddb5b1b8b08.png


Fatigue mechanics:
Now every time you spend energy on any action, a fatigue bar will progressively increase, limiting the maximum energy available. The fatigue bar increases to one-hundredth of the energy expenditure, that is, every time you spend 100 energy points, your fatigue will increase by one point. To get rid of fatigue you will only have to sleep.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931366/e7c2da9f7fc6a0db93fdd54d39932d72ec289efb.png

Interface update:
The previous version of the interface tried to be minimalist with smoke tones representing the fog that covers the planet. Apparently it was not liked at all, that is why it has been redesigned.

HUD
The status bars have been redesigned and repositioned, adding identifying icons. The action bar has been moved downwards, so as not to obstruct the field of vision.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931366/54492a340687ce0e4fde8a0cfc3962d1ba25b4ad.png
Inventory
Special slots for backpack and belt have been added. Complete redistribution of spaces.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931366/63b95bcae954bc1f85b7e3a69d9d456cd3093a8c.png
Crafting
New distribution with identifying names for each section.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931366/fff171b5e96080500816e38ad7af01066bed20ef.png
Player
Shadowing has been removed for skills that require a higher level than the current one. Descriptions of all skills can now be viewed at any time. This will help you spend your skill points more wisely.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931366/d036484ef19793f048d9f1d98db0e360bf9b3148.png
Documentation
Short descriptions have been added for all documents and access cards that will be visible when you hover over them.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931366/f10656dd60c8ab095ef641df7d3d7e3376a72c9b.png
Map
Changed the visibility icons for points of interest saved by the player. Now all visible points will appear on the minimap along with the distance separating them from the player.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931366/ca5a5cbaf2417b416dee3cc48abff2c6bcb697a8.png
Tutorials
Tutorials have been added in all sections of the interface to speed up the understanding of the game and its mechanics.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931366/64315669f8a4dfdb18e348ee8815f80f35f041ca.png


New initial level design:
When you start a new game, you begin in a bunker that you reach by falling through a hole in the ground. The purpose of the start is to introduce you to Ashun and his summons. You had to work your way through a simple 3-button puzzle, the purpose of which was to explain to the player that in this game no one was going to tell him what to do, but that he would have to explore and discover the solution. But in the end it was cumbersome and slow, causing an early rejection of the game. This first level has been simplified, now you only have a single linear path, the number of empty rooms has been reduced to a minimum so as not to confuse the player. A more comprehensive description has been added at the beginning to introduce the story of the game.


Well, that's it for update 0.7.5. I hope you enjoy the update and that the changes are positive. If any of the changes are for the worse, feel free to post a comment so we can talk about it.

notes.title: The Scar is out in early access!
notes.content:
Hello survivors! I am very proud to announce that The Scar has been released in early access. After 3 years I can finally show my work. 
What awaits you in this early version?

A procedurally generated post-apocalyptic world.
Create custom weapons and tools.
Build bases in different materials.
Explore the research facilities.
Set up the machinery to reopen the wormhole.
Team up with Ashun, an entity from another dimension trapped in our atmosphere.
Fight against alien invaders and humans mutated by radiation.

I hope you enjoy version 0.7.
